status: Completed fixed-plan CPU repack pilot; three control and three candidate runs

failure.message: Device did not meet starting conditions within bounded cooling

limits: Small sequential pilot: all control trials precede candidate trials; build order, OS caches and background activity were not randomized or fully controlled.

Only the three successful CPU-only trials per build are included; the prior mixed candidate group stopped after two valid individual trials because the phone could not cool within 120 seconds and is not pooled.
Control cooldown limit was 120 seconds; the replacement candidate CPU-only group used 180 seconds. Both retained the same thermal NORMAL and <=35 C start gate; full endpoint conditions are retained.
Initial load includes ordinary exact-request risk confirmation attempts. Repeated repository requests are separately reported and are not proof of resident reuse or model-picker latency.
Native sources and default NDK compiler are fixed, and managed DEX is byte-identical, but rebuilt Vulkan library has a separate DIAG shader constant difference. No Vulkan A/B conclusion is drawn.
Vulkan observations are individual functional validations, not a repeated distribution or a compiler comparison.
Short greedy output hashes match; this does not establish general accuracy, long-context correctness, release-model latency, cold-storage behavior or sustained throughput.

vulkanShaderRebuildDifference.detail: Twenty build-ID bytes plus two embedded diag_f16_data bytes differ. OpConstant float32 result344 changes +infinity to zero; candidate zero matches the source's zero branch. Code section and remaining ELF sections match except rodata/build-ID.
vulkanShaderRebuildDifference.interpretation: Cause of inconsistent compiled constant is unproven. DIAG is absent in saved Qwen timestamp graphs; wider shader correctness/reproducibility is untested.
